cohort: Pregnant women with singleton pregnancies who gave birth between March and July 2021 at a single tertiary center. Women with prior COVID-19 infection, multiple gestations, and stillbirth were excluded.
finding: BNT162b2 messenger RNA vaccination during pregnancy was not associated with an increased rate of adverse obstetric and neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: This study found that COVID-19 mRNA vaccination during pregnancy was not associated with an increased rate of cesarean delivery or other adverse obstetric and neonatal outcomes.
